question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Evidence
solution:
The correct answer is "**Concealment**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a word that has the opposite meaning of the given word.
 
• Now, let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Evidence means proof or something that provides support for a claim.**(प्रमाण)
 
 
• Example: They left no evidence of having been in the house
 
 
 
• **Concealment means hiding or keeping something secret.**(संवृति)
 
 
• Example: "The work of art is true by virtue of uncovering or bringing out of concealment.
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, Concealment is the most appropriate antonym of Evidence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, Signature: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way, usually as a form of identification.(हस्ताक्षर)
 
• Option 2, Duplicity: Duplicity means deceitfulness or double-dealing. It is not an antonym of Evidence.(कपट)
 
• Option 3, Information: Information means knowledge or facts about a specific subject. It is not an antonym of Evidence.(जानकारी)
